plain: Thinking about and planning something ahead of time

webster.text: The act of meditating beforehand; previous deliberation.

more.text: Previous contrivance or design formed; as the premeditation of a crime.

example.quote: Without premeditation, in a situation so novel, and awed by the respect which I feel for this venerable assembly, I distrust extremely my own feelings, as well as my competency to prosecute this inquiry.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. AMES, January 15, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
